details:
Able to do sign language in VRChat is great, but there is one problem. 
I discovered the Vive Advanced Control has less requested function to program gesture on the grab / trigger button.
Due this function, i cannot make fluid signs and must lift up finger from touchpad to avoid program the gesture. 
I really wish this function can disabled, but i want keep different speeds to move around and not old single-speed because in some worlds or in games, it's NOT good to have single-speed. I cannot turn off Vive Advanced Control for that.

The function to program gesture while press trigger button is less used than you think. Sure, it's handy for Vive users to keep gesture while move around, BUT who use this function. Who asked this function?
I don't think there is reason why to show some gesture while move around. 

And we have more sign language use in VRChat, means this programmable function will more and more in the way and just more annoying for me and others. It's better remove it or make possible to disable the function under the menu.

I have never used programmable function in 2000 hours VRChat, but variable speed is still nice and important for me.

Can you remove it - or - make it possible to disable it? Then sign language will more easier. Thank you.
title: Remove programmable gesture function (part of Vive Advanced Control)
